{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders
internal_test_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'

# Filter to completed orders excluding internal test orders
filtered = sales[completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Confirm the count of filtered rows
print(f"Number of completed orders excluding internal test: {len(filtered)}")
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue}")"}
